coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review LICENSE and REUSE.toml due to API errors (HTTP 400), resulting in an inconclusive verdict.
learnings: API errors during file review should be handled gracefully or retried to prevent false 'inconclusive' verdicts when the remaining files are safe and no security issues are found.
